translations.b0290: Part 10  Inspiring the Cultural Innovation and Creativity of the Whole Nation and Promoting the Flourishing of Socialist Culture
translations.b0291: Adhering to the guiding position of Marxism in the ideological field, taking root in the profound and extensive Chinese civilization, and keeping pace with the development of information technology, China will develop a socialist culture with Chinese characteristics for a new era that has strong power to guide thinking, to unite the spirit, to inspire values and to exert international influence, and will make solid progress in building a leading country in culture.
translations.b0292: Chapter 33  Promoting and Practicing the Core Socialist Values
translations.b0293: Cultural development will be guided by the core socialist values; mainstream values, mainstream public opinion and mainstream culture will be developed and strengthened; and the Chinese spirit, Chinese values and Chinese strength will be continuously built up.
translations.b0294: Section 1  Regularizing and Institutionalizing Education on Ideals and Convictions
translations.b0295: Study of and public education in the Party's innovative theories will be deepened, and unremitting efforts will be made to use Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era to strengthen cohesion of the mind and forge the soul; systematic and scholarly research and interpretation will be strengthened, and popular and accessible publicity and dissemination will be carried out. The Party's leadership over ideological work will be firmly maintained, and the responsibility system for ideological work will be fully implemented. The spiritual lineage of Chinese Communists will be carried forward, and education on patriotism, collectivism and socialism will be deepened. Ideological and political work will be strengthened and improved; the development of campus culture will be advanced; red resources will be put to good use; and education on ideals and convictions among young people will be strengthened. The systemic transformation of mainstream media will be deepened; integrated management of news communication and online public opinion will be advanced; and the ability to guide mainstream public opinion will be improved. The project to study and develop Marxist theory will be implemented in an innovative way, the project to innovate philosophy and social sciences will be carried out, and the building of China's independent knowledge system for philosophy and social sciences will be accelerated. The development of new types of think tanks with Chinese characteristics will be strengthened.
translations.b0296: Section 2  Raising the Level of Social Civilization
translations.b0297: Urban and rural efforts to foster cultural-ethical progress will be advanced in a coordinated way; culture will be given full play in nourishing the mind and cultivating character; and the whole nation's spirit of enterprise and vitality will be nurtured. Civic morality will be strengthened in the new era; vigorous efforts will be made to promote social morality, professional ethics, family virtues and individual morality; family education and family traditions will be improved; and ideological and moral education for minors will be strengthened. A culture of honesty and trustworthiness and a culture of integrity and probity will be promoted. Exemplary role models will be given full play in setting examples and guiding others; study and publicity of heroes and role models will be strengthened; and the system of honors and commendations will be improved. Citizens' covenants, village rules and conventions and other such instruments will be brought into play, and efforts to change outdated customs will be advanced. The working mechanisms for cultivating civilization, practicing civilized behavior and creating civilized communities will be improved and innovated.
translations.b0299: China's capacity for governance in the cultural field under IT-driven conditions will be enhanced; a positive, healthy, uplifting and wholesome online culture will be cultivated; and a beautiful spiritual home in cyberspace will be built together. The development and management of online content will be strengthened, and more effective online dissemination of the Party's innovative theories and fine traditional Chinese culture will be achieved. The development of an all-media communication system will be strengthened, and working mechanisms and evaluation systems suited to all-media production and dissemination will be established. The framework for comprehensive internet governance will be improved; long-term mechanisms for improving the online ecosystem will be refined; the production of online content and the release and dissemination of information will be regulated; and internet companies will be urged to fulfill their social responsibilities. The development and oversight of radio and television and of online audio-visual services will be advanced in a coordinated way.
translations.b0301: The public cultural service system will be improved; fine traditional Chinese culture will be carried forward and promoted; and the people will enjoy a higher quality of cultural life.
translations.b0302: Section 1  Promoting the Flourishing of Cultural Creation and Production
translations.b0303: A people-centered orientation will be upheld in cultural creation; quality improvement will be treated as the lifeline of literary and artistic creation; a sound cultural ecosystem will be fostered; and the capacity for original cultural creation will be enhanced. Working mechanisms for serving, guiding and organizing literary and artistic creation and production will be improved; a series of art creation projects for the new era will be implemented; the creation of fine works in the press and publishing, radio, film and television, and literature and art will be promoted; and new forms of mass literature and art adapted to the internet age will flourish. A large, well-structured, highly skilled and innovative cultural workforce will be cultivated. Reform of cultural institutions will be deepened, and mechanisms for the development of performing arts troupes will be improved. Comprehensive governance of the entertainment sector will be deepened.
translations.b0305: Taking culture to benefit the people, China will carry out an initiative to improve the quality and efficiency of public cultural services and ensure that high-quality cultural resources reach the grassroots directly. Mass cultural activities will be carried out extensively, and the development of amateur cultural teams will be strengthened. New types of public cultural spaces will be developed based on urban reading rooms, community cultural stations, cultural corridors and the like, so as to provide more cultural services close to the people. Various public cultural facilities and resources will be revitalized and put to good use; mechanisms for the participation of non-governmental actors in public cultural services will be improved; and reform to separate ownership from use rights for public cultural facilities will be advanced in an orderly manner. The service efficiency of smart museums, smart libraries and the public cultural cloud platform will be enhanced. Public reading activities will be deepened, and the development of a reading society will be advanced. The building of new types of radio and television networks will be strengthened, capacity for producing and broadcasting ultra-high-definition content will be enhanced, and efforts to address “matryoshka-style” tiered fees and the complicated operation of internet TV will be deepened.
translations.b0306: Section 3  Strengthening the Protection and Transmission of Cultural Heritage
translations.b0307: Systematic protection and unified oversight of cultural heritage will be promoted; management resources will be integrated; and a cultural heritage protection inspection system will be established. The project for preserving and developing fine traditional Chinese culture will be implemented in depth, and a system of symbols of Chinese civilization will be developed. The projects to trace the origins of Chinese civilization and to explore China through archaeology will be carried out. Greater efforts will be made to protect world cultural heritage, historical sites and ruins, revolutionary relics, museum collections and cultural landscapes, and effective protection and living preservation of historical and cultural cities, blocks, towns and villages will be strengthened. National cultural parks dedicated to the Great Wall, the Grand Canal, the Long March, the Yellow River and the Yangtze River will be well built and well used, and their construction and management systems and mechanisms will be improved. The protection of archival and documentary heritage and the rescue protection of ancient books will be strengthened, and the transmission of Chinese classical documents and records will be enhanced. Protection and preservation of intangible cultural heritage will be improved, and new settings for experiencing and passing on intangible heritage will be cultivated. Work on local chronicles will be strengthened and improved.
translations.b0308: Chapter 35  Accelerating the Development of Cultural Industries
translations.b0309: Cultural management systems and mechanisms for cultural production and operation will be improved; proactive cultural and economic policies will be implemented; cultural tourism will be vigorously developed; and culture will empower economic and social development.
translations.b0310: Section 1  Improving the Cultural Industry System and Market System
translations.b0311: The strategy of driving development through major cultural industry projects will be implemented, and the supply of high-quality cultural products will be expanded. Traditional cultural business forms will be upgraded; integration of culture and technology will be advanced; digital and intelligent empowerment and IT-driven transformation of cultural development will be promoted; new cultural forms such as digital animation, immersive exhibitions and performances, online streaming, short videos and micro-dramas will be developed; and the sound development of online literature, online games and online audio-visual content will be guided and regulated. The project for integrated publishing development will be implemented in depth, and reform and innovation across the entire industry chain will be deepened. Outstanding cultural enterprises and brands will be cultivated, and cultural industry parks will be encouraged to develop in a well-regulated and innovative way. The development of a cultural market that is unified and open, efficient and well-regulated, and orderly in competition will be accelerated; comprehensive law enforcement reform in the cultural market will be deepened; and reform of the approval system for film and television production, online audio-visual services and other fields will be deepened.
translations.b0312: Section 2  Deepening the Integrated Development of Culture and Tourism
translations.b0313: Efforts to shape tourism through culture and showcase culture through tourism will be deepened, and progress will be made in building a leading country in tourism. The supply of high-quality tourism products will be enriched; distinctive resources and cultural connotations will be explored in depth; and the integrated development of multiple business forms will be actively promoted. Red tourism, rural tourism, health and wellness tourism, industrial tourism and other forms will be developed in light of local conditions; study tours will be developed in a well-regulated manner; and distinctive themed tourism routes and outstanding tourism performing arts projects will be cultivated. Public tourism services will be improved, and tourism service quality will be enhanced across the entire chain. Standardized management of cultural and tourism project development will be strengthened to prevent idleness and waste. Comprehensive oversight and safety management of the tourism market will be strengthened, and the tourist consumption experience will be improved. A plan to promote inbound tourism will be implemented, and inbound tourism will be made more convenient and more internationally oriented.
translations.b0314: Chapter 36  Enhancing the Appeal and Influence of Chinese Civilization
translations.b0315: The building of a Chinese discourse and narrative system will be accelerated; the effectiveness of international communication will be enhanced; cultural exchanges and cooperation with other countries will be strengthened; and a credible, appealing and respectable image of China will be presented.
translations.b0316: Section 1  Building a More Effective International Communication System
translations.b0317: The systems and mechanisms for international communication will be improved; communication platforms and methods will be innovated; overseas communication networks will be expanded; a multi-channel, multi-dimensional framework for external communication will be built; and China's international discourse power will be comprehensively enhanced. Globalized, market-oriented and professional international communication entities will be cultivated; the international communication capacity of mainstream media will be strengthened; an international communication matrix of radio, television and audio-visual media will be built; the international development of social media platforms will be promoted; and Chinese stories and voices will be communicated globally, regionally and to targeted audiences. Cultural enterprises will be encouraged to operate internationally; high-quality online literature, online games, film, television and animation, and fine exhibitions will be promoted overseas; and the development of key international communication bases and national cultural export bases will be strengthened.
translations.b0318: Section 2  Deepening Exchanges and Mutual Learning Among Civilizations
translations.b0319: International people-to-people and cultural exchanges and cooperation will be carried out extensively, multi-level dialogue among civilizations will be strengthened, and Chinese culture will be brought to the world more effectively. The Global Civilizations Dialogue Conference will be held, and the Liangzhu Forum will continue to be held successfully. Signature events such as the “Understanding China” conference and the “Orchid Awards” will be carried out, and the China Culture and Tourism Year (Festival) and overseas Chinese film festivals and exhibitions will be well organized. International development assistance in the field of cultural heritage will be strengthened, and international cooperation on the recovery and return of cultural relics will be deepened. The dissemination and display of Chinese culture and the development of Chinese studies abroad will be supported. Regional and country studies will be strengthened.
